trail.notes: Runs east to west, Pak Tam Chung (M001) to Tuen Mun (M200), posts every 500 m. Km, hours and star difficulty are from AFCD Enjoy Hiking (1-5 stars). Post ranges were worked out by matching AFCD's official post coordinates to AFCD's official GPX track for each stage; a boundary post may be off by one. high_point.m is the official summit height; trail_max_m is the highest point on the AFCD GPX track. Supplies are sparse on stages 1, 4, 9 and 10. In an emergency call 999 and give the nearest distance post number.
trail.notes_zh: 由東向西，北潭涌（M001）至屯門（M200），每500米一支標距柱。長度、時間及星級難度取自漁護署「郊野樂行」（1至5星）。標距柱範圍是把漁護署標距柱座標對照官方GPX路線推算，分段交界的標距柱或有一支之差。high_point.m 為官方山高，trail_max_m 為GPX路線最高點。第一、四、九及十段補給很少。遇事請致電999並報上最近的標距柱編號。

exits_zh: 起步不久：左方支路經白石橋往川龍附近的仙霞洞

to_start.note_zh: 九巴；大帽山郊野公園站下車

from_end.note_zh: 田夫仔沒有車路；九巴

stages.safety_en: Most of the route is shared with a mountain-bike trail – watch for bikes; no road access at Tin Fu Tsai
stages.safety_zh: 大部分路段與越野單車徑重疊，須留意單車；田夫仔沒有車路

highlights_en: Kat Hing Bridge (1868)
Tai Lam Chung Reservoir 'Thousand Islands' viewpoint
Sweet gum woods in Tai Lam Country Park
highlights_zh: 大欖涌水塘「千島湖」景色
stages.water_en: No kiosk or supply point on route – carry all water
stages.water_zh: 沿途沒有士多或補給點，須帶備足夠食水
stages.toilets_en: Several picnic-site toilets: near M174, M177, M183, M185, M187, M193 and M196–M197 (Tuen Mun end)
stages.toilets_zh: 沿途多個郊遊地點有廁所：M174、M177、M183、M185、M187、M193及M196–M197（屯門終點）附近
exits_en: Tsing Fai Tong: down to Sham Tseng
So Kwun Wat Tsuen Road: down to So Kwun Wat village
Side path at M192: down to So Kwun Wat / Gold Coast
Steps at M196: down to Kam Fai Garden, Tuen Mun
exits_zh: 清快塘：下深井
掃管笏村路：下掃管笏村
M192旁支路：下掃管笏／黃金海岸
M196梯級：下屯門錦暉花園
